extDescription.message: Detects unprotected videos on the current page and prepares them for download.

emptyHint.message: Press play: many sites only load the media once playback starts.

drmExplanation.message: Encrypted content (DRM). It cannot legally be downloaded.

unsupportedPage.message: This page cannot be analyzed (internal browser page).

needsCompanion.message: To download HLS/DASH, install the MediaDown app for Windows.

errorForbidden.message: The server refused the download (access denied or hotlink protection).

errorExpired.message: The link expired. Reload the page, press play and try again.

errorNetwork.message: The connection dropped during the download.

errorFileAccess.message: The file could not be written. Check the folder in the options.

errorUnknown.message: The download failed for an unknown reason.

refusalNotFound.message: This media is no longer listed. Reload the page.

refusalFailed.message: The browser refused to start the download.

optionsFolderHint.message: Leave empty to save directly to Downloads. For security, the browser does not allow writing outside that folder.

optionsAskLabel.message: Ask where to save each file

companionNotInstalled.message: The MediaDown app is not installed. Run install.cmd from the app package.

companionEngineMissing.message: The MediaDown app is missing yt-dlp. Run install.cmd again.

companionIncompatible.message: Could not talk to the MediaDown app. Reinstall it and reload the extension.

companionStatusMissing.message: MediaDown app not installed: required for HLS/DASH.

errorDrm.message: The content is DRM-protected and cannot be downloaded.

errorEngineMissing.message: The MediaDown app is missing yt-dlp. Run install.cmd again.

errorInvalidRequest.message: The app rejected the request as invalid.

errorDisconnected.message: The connection to the app was lost (browser closed or app restarted).

optionsPresetHint.message: Applies to HLS/DASH and to downloads made by the MediaDown app. Direct files downloaded by the browser are saved as they are.
